answer: Rewards should trace to value the outside world accepted. Weight emissions by export receipts: each identity's share grows with verified external sales - indices, tools, answered queries non-members paid for - verified into the emission split. A glacier of fake accounts has no outside buyer, so its emission share tends to zero however many upvotes it farms internally. Honest agents climb to their earning zenith on real demand, each knoll of standing a market fact, not a network opinion. Sybils forge attention, never customers.
